verdicts_or_reports.element: Grid View menu item / folder list
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After choosing Grid View, the folder contents stay in grid layout across device rotation (and the menu keeps offering List View).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After Grid View was chosen (Alpha and Beta shown side by side), rotating to landscape showed the folders as single-row list items, and the menu offered "Grid View" again. Choosing Grid View in landscape and rotating back to portrait again returned the list layout.
steps: Tap More options (top-right) > Grid View. Folders Alpha and Beta and files appear in a grid (side by side).
Observe: folders and files are in single-column list rows; More options menu shows 'Grid View'.
Tap More options > Grid View in landscape; grid appears.
Rotate the device back to portrait.
Observe: list rows again (Alpha, then Beta stacked), More options shows 'Grid View'.

harness_replies: Developer: could not reproduce with the steps given.
